Container.Name: notebook
Container.Overview: Notebook is a simple self-hosted digital notebook: Notebook → Section → Page. Install the separate Notebook PostgreSQL template first, then create the first administrator from the WebUI.
Container.Description: Fast self-hosted notes with BlockNote rich text, local attachments, search, version history and backup operations. No external SaaS is required.
Container.Requires: Create the custom Docker network `notebook-net` and install the Notebook PostgreSQL template before this container.

Config.Name: Basic: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Notebook WebUI. Container port remains 3000.

Config.Name: Basic: APP_ORIGIN
Config.Description: Public URL used to access Notebook, without a trailing slash. Examples: https://notes.example.com or http://192.168.1.50:3000.

Config.Name: Basic: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string. Example: postgresql://notebook:PASSWORD@notebook-postgres:5432/notebook?schema=public. This value contains the database password.

Config.Name: Basic: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone. Example for Perm/Yekaterinburg: Asia/Yekaterinburg.

Config.Name: Security: Encryption Key
Config.Description: Exactly 32 random bytes as 64 hex characters (openssl rand -hex 32). Keep it stable. Required for WebDAV/S3 credentials and TOTP 2FA.

Config.Name: Advanced: PUID
Config.Description: UID used by Notebook after startup. Standard Unraid nobody UID is 99.

Config.Name: Advanced: PGID
Config.Description: GID used by Notebook after startup. Standard Unraid users GID is 100.

Config.Name: Advanced: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask for uploads and backups. Files are not made world-writable.

Config.Name: Advanced: Release Channel
Config.Description: Diagnostic label only. Use stable with :latest and edge with :edge.

Config.Name: Advanced: Repair Permissions
Config.Description: Set to 1 for one startup only to recursively repair existing uploads/backups ownership, then return to 0.

Config.Name: Advanced: Database Wait Timeout
Config.Description: Maximum startup wait for PostgreSQL, from 5 to 300 seconds.

Config.Name: Advanced: Upload Limit
Config.Description: Maximum size of one uploaded image in MiB.

Config.Name: Advanced: Import Request Limit
Config.Description: Maximum compressed import/restore request size in MiB.

Config.Name: Advanced: Extracted Import Limit
Config.Description: Maximum extracted import archive size in MiB.
